change: Explicit public batch-limit refusal for aggregate multi-CID input overflow; consumer must split outside exception frame. Singleton scalar validation and existing source/proof gates preserved.

review.cancellation: Caller checkpoints run before/between SQL queries, projections and return; BaseException rolls back owned read transaction. Nested BEGIN rejection does not rollback caller transaction.
review.canonical_integrity: Every full read reconstructs canonical AST and compares every relation; identity fence rereads live blob/file/revision.
review.concurrent_changes: Owner invalidation/replacement between batch read and CAS fence detected. Relation-only raw SQL tampering after full read is outside identity-fence claim and will be rejected by next full reconstruction.
review.memory: At most32 requested keys; aggregate encoded payload threshold64MiB and per-query100000 rows. Oversized multi-CID work is refused, never scalar-loaded into a retained oversized tuple. These are encoded-input/row bounds, not a hard Python/SQL RSS limit.
